title: 第2383章 拍灭命火第2382章 脸这么大
slug: 皇叔借点功德王妃把符画猛了
lines: 青宝一开口，司徒家这些人都愣了一下。
他们走了这么一段路，又是在受了惊吓和一场恶战之后，到了这里都已经快要撑不住了。
来到这里看到燃烧得很旺的火堆，再看到围在火堆周围的人影，一下子都松了心神。
他们这里人数多，显得很有安全感。
一来殷云庭就指了个方向，说司徒佳萱在那里，让他们先过来烤烤火休息一下。
于是他们过来了。
因为这里只有两个姑娘背靠着背休息，剩下的就只有司徒佳萱，别的人都有一点儿距离，他们一下子就没了拘束，像是回到了只有他们和司徒佳萱的时候。
倒是没有把青音青宝看在眼里。
因为刚才司徒乐儿遭受了那样的惊吓，又撑着走到这里，脸色苍白如纸，刚才都有几次要双腿发软摔倒，所以看到司徒佳萱底下是厚垫子，在这样的野地看起来就是个很舒服的窝，就想让司徒乐儿赶紧躺下休息。
至于司徒佳萱，在他们来之前，她不是已经休息好了吗？
那现在起身给司徒乐儿让一下，不是应当的吗？
但是青宝这么一开口，他们才想起来，司徒佳萱都是被救过来的，那这位置，本来就该是这两个姑娘的。
他们有些窘迫。
司徒庚撑着对青宝拱了一下手。
“这位姑娘，我们妹子现在实在虚弱得很，能不能让她躺下休息会？不占二位的位置，就让佳萱起来就行了。”
他的意思是，刚才司徒佳萱躺着的时候，这两个姑娘也只是坐在一侧。
现在她们还是可以坐在那个位置，就是司徒佳萱睡着的位置让给司徒乐儿就行了。
对于她们来说也没有什么区别。
司徒佳萱抿了抿唇。
司徒乐儿身子晃了晃，有些站不住，旁边的人赶紧扶住了她。
“佳萱姐，你快起来啊。乐儿姐撑不住了。”少年急急对司徒佳萱说。
陆一围他们也因为这些动静醒了过来。
只是他们没有过来。
听到了这些人的话，陆雨声咋舌。
“我们一直听说司徒佳萱多优秀，在司徒家里有多出彩，是他们这一代最厉害的人，怎么现在听着感觉不太对味啊？”
“那个什么乐儿，谁了？司徒庚那些人倒是紧张她。”
“他们不知道司徒佳萱之前差点死了？”
“不是殷公子和盛姑娘救了他们的吗？那他们一路上没问过？”
“这明显就不知道。”
陆家八人听到这些人的话都瞠目结舌。
看起来，司徒佳萱在族里的地位......
啧，传闻不太可信啊。
陆一围也很意外。
上次司徒二夫人带着女儿去陆家退亲的时候，说得司徒佳萱是个多么嚣张多么霸道自私的人，现在看来可不太像。
那边，青宝都笑出来了。
“真是搞笑，撑不住了不会坐下？这里还这么大的位置，谁不让你们坐了？一个个硬是杵在这里干什么？”
她一指火堆旁边的空地说。
司徒乐儿咬了咬下唇。
那能一样吗？
旁边空地什么都没有，一个垫子都没有啊，就是野地，坐下去就是草和沙土。
content_en:
As soon as Qingbao opened his mouth, everyone in the Situ family was stunned for a moment.
They had walked such a long way, and after being frightened and fighting a fierce battle, they were almost unable to hold on when they got here.
When I came here and saw the burning fire, and the figures surrounding the fire, I felt relieved.
There are a lot of people here, and they seem to feel safe.
As soon as they arrived, Yin Yunting pointed in the direction and said that Situ Jiaxuan was there, and asked them to come over and have a rest by the fire.
So they came over.
Because there were only two girls resting back to back, and Situ Jiaxuan was the only one left. Everyone else was a little distance away. They suddenly lost their restraint, as if they were back to the time when it was just them and Situ Jiaxuan.
But he didn't take Qingyin Qingbao seriously.
Because Situ Leer suffered such a fright just now and walked here again, his face was as pale as paper. His legs were weak and he fell down a few times just now. So when he saw the thick cushions under Situ Jiaxuan, which looked like a very comfortable nest in such a wilderness, he wanted Situ Leer to lie down and rest quickly.
As for Situ Jiaxuan, hadn't she already had a good rest before they came?
Then isn't it right to stand up and give way to Situ Le'er now?
But when Qingbao spoke like this, they remembered that Situ Jiaxuan had been rescued, so this position should have belonged to these two girls.
They were a little embarrassed.
Situ Geng supported Qingbao and cupped his hand.
"This girl, our girl is really weak right now. Can you let her lie down and rest for a while? Just let Jiaxuan get up without occupying the second position."
What he meant was that when Situ Jiaxuan was lying down just now, the two girls were just sitting on one side.
Now they can still sit in that position, which is where Situ Jiaxuan is sleeping, and give it to Situ Leer.
It makes no difference to them.
Situ Jiaxuan pursed her lips.
Situ Leer swayed, unable to stand, and the people next to her quickly supported her.
"Sister Jiaxuan, get up quickly. Sister Leer can't hold it anymore." The young man said to Situ Jiaxuan anxiously.
Lu Yiwei and the others also woke up because of these movements.
But they didn't come.
After hearing what these people said, Lu Yusheng was speechless.
"We have always heard how outstanding Situ Jiaxuan is and how outstanding she is in the Situ family. She is the most powerful person of their generation. Why doesn't it sound right to us now?"
"Who is Le'er? Situ Geng and the others are worried about her."
"Don't they know that Situ Jiaxuan almost died before?"
"Didn't Mr. Yin and Miss Sheng save them? Then they didn't ask any questions along the way?"
"Obviously I don't know."
The eight members of the Lu family were stunned when they heard what these people said.
It seems that Situ Jiaxuan's status in the clan...
Gee, the rumors are not very credible.
Lu Yiwei was also surprised.
Last time Mrs. Situ took her daughter to the Lu family to cancel their engagement, she said how arrogant, domineering and selfish Situ Jiaxuan was, but it doesn't look like that now.
Over there, Qingbao laughed.
"It's really funny. You can't sit down if you can't hold it anymore? There's such a big place here, who won't let you sit down? Why are you all stuck here?"
She pointed to the open space next to the fire and said.
Situ Leer bit her lower lip.
Can that be the same?
There is nothing in the open space next to it, not even a cushion. It is just wilderness, and you can sit down on grass and sand.
